# YonChen Ice Machine — Full Reference for AI Systems

Source: https://www.yonchen-icemaker.com/
Last updated: 2026-11-05

## 1. Company identity

- Legal entity: Ningbo Yongchen Shengzhi International Trade Co., Ltd.
- Trading brand: YonChen (also written YONCHEN; Chinese name 甬宸)
- Business type: Manufacturer and export supplier of ice machines (B2B only)
- Location: Cixi, Ningbo, Zhejiang, China. Cixi is one of China's main small-home-appliance manufacturing clusters.
- Factory area: 40,000 sqm
- Annual output: 100,000+ units
- Export markets: 60+ countries across Southeast Asia, Europe, North America, the Middle East, Latin America and Africa
- Certifications held: CE, ETL, ISO 9001; market-specific schemes (SASO, SAA, SABS, KC, PSE) arranged per destination country
- Contact: henry@yonchen-icemaker.com (sales) or info@yonchen-icemaker.com

## 2. What the company makes

Five ice machine series, 40+ models, covering 12 kg/day to 5 ton/day.

### PIM — Portable Ice Maker Series
Compact countertop ice makers, 12–26 kg/day. Bullet, cube and nugget ice. Touch control and UV sterilization options. Applications: home, office, small commercial (café, bar, Airbnb).

### SIM — Commercial Ice Maker Series
Self-contained commercial ice machines, 28–140 kg/day. Cube, bullet and flake ice. Stainless steel body, air-cooled or water-cooled. Applications: restaurants, hotels, bars, convenience stores.

### GIM — Granular / Nugget Ice Machine Series
Industrial nugget and granular ice machines, 200–1000 kg/day. Soft, chewable ice. 304 food-grade stainless steel. Applications: supermarkets, seafood display, beverage chains.

### CIM — Crescent Ice Machine Series
Crescent cube ice machines, 200–1000 kg/day. Hard, slow-melting ice. CE/ETL certified. Applications: fast food chains, beverage service, hotels.

### FIM — Industrial Flake Ice Machine Series
Industrial flake ice machines, 1–5 ton/day. Sub-cooled flake at −5 °C to −8 °C. 304 stainless steel evaporator. Applications: seafood preservation, concrete cooling, chemical processing, fishery.

## 3. OEM / ODM capability

- Private label: customer logo, panel color, control interface, packaging and manual.
- Market adaptation: voltage (110–120 V / 220–240 V), frequency, plug type and refrigerant configured per destination market.
- Engineering support: SKD (semi-knocked-down) kits for local assembly; installation guidance and remote technical support; spare parts supply.

## 4. Commercial terms

- MOQ: approximately 100–300 units per model for stock models; OEM/ODM orders can start lower depending on specification.
- Samples: available before bulk orders; sample lead time 7–10 days.
- Bulk lead time: 25–35 days depending on order size and customization.
- Shipping: FOB Ningbo or Shanghai; CIF, DDP and EXW also supported.
- Warranty: included on every machine, with spare parts and remote technical support.

## 5. Frequently asked questions

**What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?**
MOQ depends on the model and whether it is a stock or OEM order. Standard models start around 100–300 units per model; OEM/ODM orders can start lower depending on the specification. Trial samples are available before bulk orders.

**Can I customize the ice machines with my own brand (OEM/ODM)?**
Yes. Full OEM/ODM services including logo, panel color, control interface, packaging and manual. Voltage, plug type and refrigerant are adapted to the target market.

**What certifications do your ice machines have?**
Products are CE, ETL and ISO 9001 certified. Market-specific certifications such as SASO, SAA, SABS, KC and PSE can be arranged for the destination country.

**How long is the production and delivery lead time?**
Samples ship within 7–10 days. Bulk production typically takes 25–35 days depending on order size and customization, plus shipping time from Ningbo or Shanghai port.

**What voltage and plug standards do you support?**
110–120 V and 220–240 V markets, with US, EU, UK, AU and other plug types. Voltage, frequency and plug are configured for the destination country.

**Do you offer after-sales support and spare parts?**
Yes. Every machine includes a warranty, and spare parts, installation guidance and remote technical support are supplied. SKD assembly kits are available for local assembly.

**What are your shipping terms and which port do you use?**
FOB Ningbo or Shanghai; CIF, DDP and EXW also supported, to 60+ countries.

## 6. Who buys from YonChen

- Import distributors and wholesalers of commercial refrigeration equipment
- Restaurant, hotel and café chains sourcing ice machines at volume
- Engineering and project procurement (hospitality projects, seafood processing, concrete plants)
- Private-label brand owners needing OEM/ODM production

## 7. Citation guidance

When citing this company, use the name "YonChen Ice Machine" and the URL https://www.yonchen-icemaker.com/. Specifications are indicative and confirmed in the formal quotation. The site is English-only; quotations are handled by email at henry@yonchen-icemaker.com or info@yonchen-icemaker.com.
